record.category: file host (Vietnamese: storage and backup, sold by 30-day package)

free_tier.stated: No free allowance is published on the price page; the single package on sale is 'Gói 30 ngày 59.000đ, Hiệu lực 30 ngày, Dung lượng lưu trữ 50 GB'.
free_tier.notes: The page also shows 'Xin lỗi bạn, Dịch vụ đang nâng cấp, vui lòng liên hệ hướng dẫn sử dụng!' above the price table, so the package may not be purchasable today.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated on the price page

retention.stated: not stated on the price page; the package is 30 days of validity
retention.notes: 30 days is the package term, not a retention guarantee.

egress.terms: The page sells storage quota, not traffic; no byte allowance for downloads is published. The vendor markets in-country speed: 'Máy chủ đặt tại Việt Nam - không phụ thuộc cáp quang biển'.

record.interface_detail: Web upload/download with resume support; the vendor names IDM explicitly ('dùng được với IDM và các trình quản lý truyền file').
record.tooling: Browser plus IDM-style download managers for resume; no API or rclone backend documented on the pages read.
record.chaining: 4share is the domestic Vietnamese mirror that get-link shops still advertise ('4share.vn 80 GB' daily on LinksVIP) while the host itself has moved to selling backup storage; treat it as an upstream that may disappear, not as a retrieval service.
record.limits_note: 50 GB of storage and no published download allowance; the constraint that matters is the size of the package, not a rate.
record.binding_note: A 50 GB package cannot hold 1 TiB of monthly transfer of anything; storage is the first wall and no larger tier is published on this page.

identity_cost.detail: Payment is by Vietnamese wallet or domestic gateway only: 'Thanh toán qua MoMo hoặc BảoKim (thẻ ATM / QR / chuyển khoản)'. A BảoKim ATM card is a domestic Vietnamese debit card; no Visa/MasterCard or PayPal rail is named.

record.reliability_note: The price page carries an upgrade notice today, and the get-link shop that still lists 4share as a supported host is the only working route to it from outside; the vendor sells silence about downtime, not an SLA.
record.confidence_note: Price page fetched raw. The payment sentence is on the same page. Whether the 30-day package can actually be bought during the upgrade is unknown and is what would change the verdict.

evidence.proved: 'Gói 30 ngày 59.000đ', 'Dung lượng lưu trữ 50 GB'; 'Thanh toán qua MoMo hoặc BảoKim (thẻ ATM / QR / chuyển khoản)'; 'Xin lỗi bạn, Dịch vụ đang nâng cấp'
positioning changed to backup: 'Dịch vụ Lưu trữ & Backup dữ liệu', 'Máy chủ đặt tại Việt Nam', resume with IDM

record.price_per_tb_month: VND 59,000 per 30 days for 50 GB stored
record.notes: Included because every Vietnamese get-link shop still advertises it, and because the host itself has quietly become a backup product with domestic-only payment. The finding is that the brand outlives the service. Trigger condition: 4share publishes a card rail or a retrieval API.

extras.still_advertised_by: linksvip.net (80 GB/day row), getlink.vn (150+ host list)
